newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Foreign capital leads Brazil M&As in H1 - report.
newsitem.headline: Foreign capital leads Brazil M&As in H1 - report.

text.p: Brazil saw 172 mergers and acquisitions in the first half of 1997, of which 86 involving purchases of local firms by foreign companies, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper reported Thursday.

According to a survey by KPMG Peat Marwick consulting firm, 1,005 deals worth $33 billion were seen between 1992 and June this year, of which 567 worth $20 billion involved foreign firms, the newspaper said.

Last year, mergers and acquisitions in Brazil rose 53 percent to a record 328, compared with 1995, a previous KPMG survey showed. Foreign companies were involved in 165 deals, or roughly 50 percent of the total in 1996.
